name: Haywire Field Effects
description: Black Crusade, Table 5-2 (p. 152). Rolled each round for the strength of a Haywire field. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.name: Minor Disruption
results.text: -10 to all actions using technology: firing ranged weapons without the Primitive quality, Tech-Use Tests, and physical actions in power armour or using cybernetics. Base Movement in power armour is reduced by 1.

results.name: Major Disruption
results.text: -20 to all actions using technology, as Minor Disruption. Base Movement in power armour is reduced by 3. Melee weapons with technological components function as a Primitive weapon of their type.

results.name: Dead Zone
results.text: Technology in the area ceases to function. Power armour is unpowered and the wearer's Movement drops to 1. Characters with cybernetic internal organs take 1 level of Fatigue each round they remain in the zone. Melee weapons with technological components function as Primitive weapons of their type.

results.name: Prolonged Dead Zone
results.text: As Dead Zone, but the field lasts two rounds, lessening to Dead Zone during the following round.
